Third-party code bundled with the app (loaded only when needed):

jsQR.js  - jsQR 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe, Apache License 2.0 - https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
           Reads QR codes from the camera on the customer's order page.
qrcode.js - QR Code Generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License - https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
           Draws the order and counter QR codes on the POS.
